title: BECE English Studies: Grammar & Structure - English Studies - Parts of Speech - Verbs
subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Identify the auxiliary verb in the following sentence:
"The students have finished their assignment."
questions.explain: An auxiliary (or helping) verb accompanies the main verb to indicate tense. In this sentence, 'have' is the auxiliary verb assisting the main verb 'finished' to form the present perfect tense.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Select the correct verb to complete the sentence:
"The dog has _____ on the rug for three hours."
questions.explain: The sentence requires the past participle of the verb 'to lie' (meaning to rest). The principal parts of this verb are lie, lay, lain. 'Has lain' is the correct present perfect form.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Complete the sentence with the correct verb form:
"I always enjoy _____ fictional novels in my free time."
questions.explain: The verb 'enjoy' is a transitive verb that must be followed by a gerund (an -ing form functioning as a noun), not an infinitive. Therefore, 'reading' is correct.
questions.subject: English Studies

questions.q:
Choose the correct verb to complete the sentence:
"The strict teacher made him _____ for his bad behavior."
questions.explain: The causative verb 'make' (when used in the active voice) is followed by an object and a bare infinitive (the base form of the verb without 'to'). Therefore, 'apologize' is correct.
questions.subject: English Studies
